items.title: 5 reasons you still need to learn Git in 2026
items.summary:
Your AI agent can do all the Git work for you. Here's why you should still know it.

Full Git tutorial: https://youtu.be/c5TSRxrDEK8

So we build a tiny repo (a website and a zombie story), then save it, break it, restore it, and jump back in time with the DeLorean.
